models_evaluated: GPT-4 hybrid (LLM feature classification plus deterministic formula)

links.outcome: O-RADS MRI score accuracy of AI strategies versus original reporting radiologists on the same lesions
links.effect: Hybrid model accuracy exceeded reporting radiologists (97% [153/158] vs 88% [139/158]; P = .004); hybrid also outperformed LLM-only (97% vs 90%; P = .006).
links.quote: For lesions with an originally reported O-RADS score, hybrid model accuracy exceeded that of reporting radiologists (97% [153 of 158] vs 88% [139 of 158]; P = .004).

unlisted_practices: Combining LLM feature classification with a deterministic rule-based formula (hybrid architecture) to improve accuracy over LLM-only scoring
Prompt optimization with few-shot learning on a training subset

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM extraction of features combined with deterministic rule calculation versus unconstrained direct LLM score generation on clinical radiology reports.

primary.practice: deterministic rule-based grounding/formula calculation vs raw LLM generation
